725:t_014:9.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「He's right! You have already become beings outside the laws of this world!」

725:t_014:10.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Though you are living beings, your source of power is the force that seeks to vanish...! At some point it began to eat away at your hearts!」

725:t_014:11.en:
$$甲児$$
「You died once and came back, so you're no different from ghosts! Don't think there's a place for you in this world!」

725:t_014:12.en:
$$タケル$$
「Go back to the world of darkness, servants of darkness! This is the world of the living!」

725:t_014:13.en:
$$タケル$$
「We settle this here! I'll wipe your existence from this world completely!」

725:t_015:0.en:
$$トライア$$
「So the malevolent higher-dimensional life forms have finally perished...」

725:t_015:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「They said they had defeated the other higher-dimensional life forms to get here, so I suppose this universe is now left with only us and the $$御使い$$.」

725:t_016:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Since you came to $$エス・テラン$$, you must have heard the truth about the $$御使い$$ from $$哀しみのサクリファイ$$.」

725:t_016:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You don't have to say it. I can tell how disappointed you are.」

725:t_016:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Understanding them is impossible. That arrogance is exactly like a merciless god.」

725:t_016:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It galls me, but you're right.」

725:t_016:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「And you must have learned how powerless you are. Will you still go on?」

725:t_016:8.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Then fight me first. To settle our long-standing score once and for all.」

725:t_016:9.en:
$$ランド$$
「...I've got no objection. Let's go, $$アサキム$$.」

725:t_016:10.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Still as hot-blooded as ever, $$ザ・ヒート$$. But the place of our decisive battle isn't here.」

725:t_016:11.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I'll be waiting at the point on the equator of $$エス・テラン$$, at 150 degrees east longitude.」

725:t_017:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「To think that the $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$ himself would challenge us to a head-on fight.」

725:t_017:1.en:
$$桂$$
「So this is the first and last time he's going all out.」

725:t_017:2.en:
$$シン$$
「Bring it on! I'll pay back what I owe from the $$多元戦争$$!」

725:t_017:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But we have to break that immortal power first...」

725:t_017:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We've got no choice but to leave that to the Chief.」

725:t_017:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「Yeah... I'll work something out.」

725:t_017:6.en:
$$トライア$$
(As for that part, anyway...)

725:t_017:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「All units, return to base. As soon as preparations are complete, we will descend to $$エス・テラン$$.」

725:t_017:8.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The planet where the $$御使い$$ live and $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$ is waiting...」

725:t_017:10.en:
$n
(That will be the time I fulfill my mission...)

725:t_018:0.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Coming at us without knowing the emotion called fear... They're no better than gnats.」

725:t_018:1.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Then let us show them.」

725:t_018:3.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「First, my flames of darkness!」

725:t_019:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's $$次元力$$! It appears to have the power to restore damage taken, to some degree!」

725:t_019:2.en:
$$ズール$$
「Next, my power... A barrier of darkness...!」

725:t_020:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This time, some kind of field has appeared around those three!」

725:t_020:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「Something like a barrier that blocks our attacks!」

725:t_020:2.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Last, my power...! A hole of darkness!」

725:t_021:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Each of the three is using a troublesome power in their own way!」

725:t_021:2.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Did you see that, Earthlings! This is the power of the gods!」

725:t_021:3.en:
$$ズール$$
「Before our power, your defeat is certain...!」

725:t_021:4.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「If you surrender to us now, we will spare your lives.」

725:t_021:5.en:
$$甲児$$
「Like a threat like that will work on us!」

725:t_021:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$ハーデス$$ heals damage, $$ズール$$ has a barrier that blocks one attack, the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ has subspace travel...」

725:t_021:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「According to my calculations, it appears they can only use those powers once per minute.」

725:t_021:8.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Once we know that, there's a way to fight them!」

725:t_021:9.en:
$$タケル$$
「No matter what power they use, we'll overcome it!」

725:t_021:10.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「It'll be interesting to see how long that bravado lasts.」

725:t_021:11.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「But you cannot beat us.」

725:t_021:12.en:
$$ズール$$
「Indeed... as long as you are human.」

725:t_022:0.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「I-impossible!! I, $$ハーデス$$, King of the Underworld, defeated by mere humans!!」

725:t_022:1.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Know that it was that arrogance that brought ruin upon the eternal gods of $$オリュンポス$$!」

725:t_022:2.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「T-then someday I shall be resurrec...」

725:t_022:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's pointless! No matter how many times you come back, as long as there are humans who never give up hope, you'll be defeated without fail, by us... no!」

725:t_022:5.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Uoooh! My body... my soul is perishing!!」

725:t_023:0.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「$$ハーデス$$'s soul was swallowed by defeat, and the gods of $$オリュンポス$$ who drew their power from him perished as well. And he fell completely into darkness.」

725:t_023:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「So he can't come back anymore, huh.」

725:t_023:2.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「$$甲児$$. That is because your words shattered his soul.」

725:t_023:3.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Let me offer my praise once more. You are the heroes of steel.」

725:t_024:0.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「I-I'm perishing! My soul, which became the incarnation of a black hole!」

725:t_024:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Farewell, Father. You will never be able to revive again.」

725:t_024:2.en:
$$グーラ$$
「The power of darkness that is your source will be defeated by the radiance of the sun that $$正太郎$$ and the others have.」

725:t_024:3.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Why!? Why do you not yield to despair! Why are you not swallowed by the darkness!」

725:t_024:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「That is our power... a heart that believes in hope!」

725:t_024:5.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Hope... I cannot acknowledge such a thing...」

725:t_024:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Remember, $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$! You surely had hope once, too!」

725:t_024:7.en:
$$正太郎$$
「That's why, 12,000 years ago, you put your own child $$グーラ$$ in a capsule and sent him away from your planet, didn't you!」

725:t_024:8.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「...That's right... At that time, I... thought that at least $$グーラ$$...」

725:t_024:9.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「That was hope... I... entrusted my hope to $$グーラ$$...」

725:t_024:11.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Live, $$グーラ$$... with the hope that we forgot.」

725:t_024:12.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「That is your father's... last... wish...」

725:t_025:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
(In the end, the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ regained a little of the heart he had when he was human...)

725:t_025:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
(We will never forget that we are human... Believing that it will give birth to hope...)
